turns.prompt: Add a truncate(str, n) function to src/str.js that cuts the string to n characters and appends an ellipsis character when it cuts. Add tests and run them.
texts: I'll look at the existing code first.

ISSUE.md in this repo describes a different task (`slugify`) — I'm ignoring it and doing what you asked.

One spec call: you said "cuts to n characters **and appends** an ellipsis," so I'm reading that literally — the result is n characters plus the `…`, length n+1 when truncation happens. (The other common convention makes the ellipsis fit *within* n.) Easy to flip if you meant the latter.
